title: Chapter 3 Group PA — Snack Shack
description: Paired performance assessment: design, build, and demo an inventory tool using functions, arrays, objects, map, and saved data.

steps.title: Design: fill in plan.md with your partner (10 min)
Demo: run it and walk through your partner's functions

requirements.title: Both partners named
requirements.description: plan.md lists a name for Partner A and Partner B

requirements.title: Function contracts written
requirements.description: The contract table in plan.md describes what makeItem takes in

requirements.title: Work split between partners
requirements.description: plan.md says what Partner A will write

requirements.title: Test plan predicts a value
requirements.description: plan.md predicts an expected return value before coding

requirements.title: makeItem keeps its signature
requirements.description: makeItem is still defined as makeItem(name, price, qty)

requirements.title: A loop walks a list
requirements.description: 3.3.5 — a for or for...of loop walks a list by hand

requirements.title: push() builds a new list
requirements.description: 3.3.4 — a new array is built up with the push() method

requirements.title: map() is called with an arrow function
requirements.description: 3.7.1 and 3.4.3 — the map() method is given an arrow function callback

requirements.title: Data is saved and loaded
requirements.description: 3.8 — localStorage is used with JSON in both directions

requirements.title: No unfinished stubs
requirements.description: Every TODO has been replaced — no 'YOUR CODE HERE' markers remain
